title: auricula-ursi carniolica
intro: Auricula-ursi carniolica, commonly known as bearberry or kinnikinnick, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to Europe and North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and diarrhea, due to its antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antiseptic, astringent, and anti-diarrheal effects, making it a popular remedy for urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of bearberry include arbutin, a glycoside that has been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
